name: plugin.okf_memory
description: Git-native agent memory governor providing BM25 search, pre-edit governance scoping, concept mutations, and trust ordering validation
author: Brain Harness Forge Engine

entrypoints.name: okf_search
entrypoints.description: Search knowledge bundle using BM25 lexical ranking or evaluate for-path governance constraints before modifying code

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search query terms to match against concept headers and bodies

parameters.name: for_path
parameters.description: Target source code path to retrieve governing concepts before editing

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of matching concepts to return (default: 3)

parameters.name: bundle_dir
parameters.description: Custom root directory of the knowledge bundle (default: 'knowledge')

entrypoints.name: okf_show
entrypoints.description: Retrieve full markdown content, frontmatter metadata, and governance rules for a specific concept

parameters.name: concept_id
parameters.description: Unique concept identifier (e.g. auth-middleware)

parameters.name: bundle_dir
parameters.description: Custom root directory of the knowledge bundle (default: 'knowledge')

entrypoints.name: okf_create
entrypoints.description: Create a new concept document with frontmatter sanitization and automatic parent index and log updating

parameters.name: concept_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the new concept

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Human-readable concept title

parameters.name: concept_type
parameters.description: Type of concept: 'decision', 'architecture', 'operational', or 'concept'

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: High-density 1-2 sentence description

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Markdown body content

parameters.name: governance
parameters.description: List of governance constraints or architectural invariants

parameters.name: code_refs
parameters.description: List of codebase file or directory paths related to this concept

parameters.name: bundle_dir
parameters.description: Custom root directory of the knowledge bundle (default: 'knowledge')

entrypoints.name: okf_update
entrypoints.description: Update an existing concept document with automatic parent index and audit log synchronization

parameters.name: concept_id
parameters.description: Identifier of the concept to update

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Updated concept title

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Updated high-density 1-2 sentence summary

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Updated markdown body content

parameters.name: governance
parameters.description: Updated governance rules or invariants

parameters.name: code_refs
parameters.description: Updated list of codebase file or directory paths

parameters.name: bundle_dir
parameters.description: Custom root directory of the knowledge bundle (default: 'knowledge')

entrypoints.name: okf_relate
entrypoints.description: Link two concepts together bidirectionally in frontmatter relations

parameters.name: source_id
parameters.description: Source concept identifier

parameters.name: target_id
parameters.description: Target concept identifier

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: Relationship rationale or dependency nature

parameters.name: bundle_dir
parameters.description: Custom root directory of the knowledge bundle (default: 'knowledge')

entrypoints.name: okf_validate
entrypoints.description: Validate knowledge bundle against OKF normative schema, link consistency, and actor trust ordering

parameters.name: strict
parameters.description: Whether to fail validation on non-critical hygiene warnings (default: false)

parameters.name: bundle_dir
parameters.description: Custom root directory of the knowledge bundle (default: 'knowledge')
